figures.caption: Fig. 1. Our method allows MPM to handle world space material cutting, complex thin boundaries and natural two-way rigid body coupling. Additional Key Words and Phrases: Material Point Method (MPM), moving least squares, cutting, discontinuity, distance field, rigid coupling In this paper, we introduce the Moving Least Squares Material Point Method (MLS-MPM). MLS-MPM naturally leads to the formulation of Affine Particle- In-Cell (APIC) [Jiang et al. 2015] and Polynomial Particle-In-Cell [Fu et al. 2017] in a way that is consistent with a Galerkin-style weak form discretiza- tion of the governing equations. Additionally, it enables a new stress di- vergence discretization that effortlessly allows all MPM simulations to run two times faster than before.
